newsitem.title: CHAD: Chad orders systematic arms search at schools.
newsitem.headline: Chad orders systematic arms search at schools.

text.p: Chad ordered security forces to start a systematic search for weapons at schools after the attentions of love-struck male student triggered a fight in which another high school boy died last week.

An education ministry statement said on Sunday security forces would search all pupils and visitors entering schools in the Central African country, adding: "Any pupil found with a weapon will be immediately expelled."
The ministry said the violence at N'Djamena's Liberty High School started when a boy from an adjoining classroom tried to talk to a girlfriend in the middle of a lesson next door.
Other students complained of being disturbed and in the ensuing fight a boy died from multiple stab wounds.
The incident trigered violence in other schools in which firearms were used. No other casualties were reported.
Firearms circulate easily in Chad, which has was gripped by decades of civil strife or war with neighbouring Libya until 1990.
